description: This Java source file defines the CartEventListener class, which implements HttpSessionListener to handle events related to HTTP session lifecycle, specifically managing abandoned shopping cart data upon session destruction.

classes.name: CartEventListener
classes.description: Implements HttpSessionListener to listen for session creation and destruction events, specifically to save abandoned shopping cart details when a session ends.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles the event when a session is created. Currently, it logs that nothing is done upon session creation.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles the event when a session is destroyed. If a shopping cart exists in the session, it attempts to save its data as an abandoned cart record in the database, managing entity transactions and error handling.
